analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, discussing operational and financial performance amidst supply-side constraints, raw material inflation, and geopolitical tensions in West Asia. Management reported consolidated quarterly revenue of ₹532 crore and EBITDA of ₹89 crore, supported by backward integration, disciplined procurement, and the introduction of new complex fertilizer variants. The company expressed confidence in achieving robust volume and revenue growth over the remaining quarters of FY27 as monsoon conditions improve and raw material availability normalizes. Krishana Phoschem Limited released its financial results presentation for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting strong operational and financial performance with a 34.58% YoY increase in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY increase in PAT to ₹47.06 crore. Management highlighted that expanded capacities at Meghnagar-specifically NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA-are progressively contributing to performance alongside a favorable demand environment supported by improving monsoons and government subsidy frameworks.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver revenue growth of around 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line revenue to increase by around Rs. 500 crore in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that fertilizer sales remained strong despite lower industry production levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite lower production levels, sales remained strong, with NPK sales increasing by 33% year- on-year and SSP sales growing by 28% year-on-year during the same period.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, triggering a rapid acceleration in Kharif growing across the primary marketing zone.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure, and any softness would first be absorbed by imports.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure. Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported. Therefore, any impact would first be absorbed by imports, and domestic manufacturers would remain relatively insulated.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable despite a slightly lower monsoon forecast because reservoir and water levels are higher.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its NPK-DAP capacity by 165,000 MT, taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: So far, no additional expansion or capex plans beyond the implemented plants have been planned.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Overall, the company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs tightened towards the latter part of the quarter due to supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the closing quarter.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 decreased slightly to 12.34% from 13.54% due to trading turnover impacting blended margins.
margins_costs.quote: Our overall EBITDA margin, which was 13.54% has come down to 12.34%.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27 due to absorbed input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the quarter was 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for the quarter reached 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT during the quarter driven by peak Rabi season demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Certain NPK/DAP and SSP units operated above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production for FY26 stood at 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes for FY26 were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing equity share face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable).
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to highlight that our credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable), reflecting improved financial strength and business fundamentals

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable cost pressures and delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore and finance costs increased from ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore following capacity commissioning.
risks_headwinds.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore. These costs have increased because of the newly commissioned plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially due to market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements related to Krishana Phoschem Limited (KRISHANA) are based on current expectations and projections that involve a number of risks and uncertainties. Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred where domestic demand slowed down in March while input costs were increasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia third-party capacity arrangement with SECI will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains focused on disciplined execution and long-term value creation through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the benefits of the capacity expansion to reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
